messages:
anya: Kicking off tri-region rollout for v2.3.0 — plan US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 23:00–01:00 UTC. Need capacity sanity, pin rules, and rollback readiness. @matt @lina please watch metrics.

deploy-bot: [deploy] starting canary: target=us-canary, weight=20%
```
Starting step: canary(us)
image: redwood/service:v2.3.0
traffic: 20%
health-check: enabled
```

matt: US canary smoke looks good. p50=82ms p95=210ms, 5xx=0.03%. No anomalies in logs.

george: Confirming reserved GPU pool usage in us-east at 70% current. We have headroom to widen canary but recommend keeping EU hold until warmpool finishes.

lina: EU warmup in progress — spinning 4 warm instances (eu-west-1). ETA ~6m to steady-state. Recommend soft-pin v2.3.0 for EU for 10m post-warm to observe.

anya: Soft-pin EU for 10m. APAC start targeted ~00:40 UTC after EU steady. Release notes pushed: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/v2.3.0 (internal)

sre-bot: [alert] traffic delta: us-west +12% concurrent vs baseline; error-rate unchanged. tagging @matt for visibility.

matt: Seeing the +12% but errors stable, looks like client retry fanout. Holding EU for 3 more minutes to confirm no delayed regressions. Rollback threshold set: errors >0.5% or p95 >350ms sustained 5m.

george: APAC capacity check: quota shows 60 GPUs available. Warm-pool planned consumes 12 GPUs. Autoscale headroom ~1.8x. If EU steady, APAC proceed OK.

anya: Decision: proceed EU -> APAC if EU steady. Rollback plan: CLI rollback to v2.2.9 via deploy-bot if thresholds breach. @matt you have final call on rollback for US/EU; @jin oncall for APAC.

deploy-bot: progressing canary -> eu-warmup
```
eu-warmup: added 4 instances
health: passing
sync: kv-cache prefill OK
```

lina: EU metrics: p50=95ms p95=230ms, 5xx=0.02%. No regressions in 5m window. Soft-pin ticking (remaining ~6m).

anya: Starting APAC rollout now. @jin are you oncall for APAC watch?

jin: Oncall: here and watching. I'll monitor thermal throttling and infra alarms for 15m. Prepared to pin asia-east1 if we see any exec-level anomalies.

deploy-bot: rollout apac started -> target weight=60%

matt: APAC smoke checks green. Latency p95=275ms steady, canary tasks passed. Scheduling post-release perf diff summary to releases channel in 30m.

anya: Thanks all :thumbsup: Leaving monitors open until EOD for any late regressions. If anyone sees sustained error-rate >0.5% or p95 >350ms for >5m call rollback immediately. Will close thread after final postmortem or if clean.
